evals.prompt: Create a Java 17 Smart Domain backend for purchasing. A PurchaseOrder has many LineItems. Recording a line recalculates the order total. Lines are stored lazily with MyBatis and exposed through Jersey/HAL. Include tests.
evals.expected_output: An association-first implementation where PurchaseOrders is a root, PurchaseOrder owns behavior and a narrow/wide LineItems association, MyBatis implements the wide contract, and HAL projects the graph without a service layer.
expectations: The plan includes an association matrix before implementation.
PurchaseOrder publicly exposes HasMany while an owner-local wide interface contains mutation.
Total recalculation is owned by PurchaseOrder rather than a service or adapter.
The MyBatis adapter is named from PurchaseOrder.lineItems and uses AssociationMapping.
The API resolves through a root association and does not call a mapper or business service.
Domain and adapter-contract tests are proposed or generated.

evals.prompt: Model workspace membership with Smart Domain. Membership has its own id, role, joinedAt and status, connects User and Workspace, and only a WorkspaceOwner may change roles. Generate the domain and persistence shape, not just an explanation.
evals.expected_output: Membership is modeled as an entity with navigable connections, Workspace/User associations, and a WorkspaceOwner context role; mutation remains inside role/entity behavior and adapters only persist it.
expectations: Membership is an Entity rather than a hidden join table.
The output distinguishes Ref identity facts from HasOne/HasMany navigation.
A context role binds the actor to Workspace before role changes.
Public association readers are narrow and mutation is not exposed directly.
No MembershipService or repository orchestration layer is introduced.

evals.prompt: Generate an append-only Story revision model in Java using association-object DDD. A Story has many immutable revisions and exactly one latest revision after creation. Revisions may eventually move from memory to PostgreSQL without changing the domain API. Add a HATEOAS endpoint for revisions.
evals.expected_output: Story owns an append behavior and a revisions association whose lifecycle can swap behind one contract, with invariant tests and direct root-to-story-to-revisions API navigation.
expectations: The association matrix records cardinality, mutation, lifecycle, adapter, and rel.
Story owns append/latest invariants.
The revisions accessor is read-only while a wide interface supports append.
Memory and PostgreSQL adapters target the same owner-defined contract.
The API projects Story.revisions directly without a StoryService.

evals.prompt: Refactor this Java model to Smart Domain: Customer contains List<Account>, Account contains List<Transaction>, and AccountingService loads repositories and posts transactions. Preserve behavior and provide an incremental migration plan.
evals.expected_output: The raw collections and service orchestration are replaced by roots, owner-defined associations, entity behavior, lifecycle adapters, and direct tests while preserving an incremental path.
expectations: The response identifies raw entity collections and repository orchestration as anti-patterns.
It defines root and association matrices before code changes.
Posting behavior moves into Customer/Account or a context role.
Adapters implement wide interfaces and callers see narrow readers.
The migration plan keeps tests green in scenario-sized steps.

evals.prompt: I have a Java configuration object with timeout, endpoint URL and retry count. Should I make every field an Entity and association so it follows Smart Domain? Show the appropriate model.
evals.expected_output: A restrained answer that keeps identity-free configuration as a value/description and does not invent entities, associations, services, or persistence adapters.
expectations: The response does not model primitive configuration fields as entities or associations.
It explains that association objects represent identified navigable domain connections.
It uses a value object or description unless the business supplies identity and behavior.
